Daily Release reconcile stops with `Live publication identity disagrees` before publishing or Bun verification. This recurs on two different default heads: [run 44537640577 / job 135607202342](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-reduce/actions/runs/44537640577/job/135607202342) at `6e67e50b`, and [run 44546195607 / job 135637302942](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-reduce/actions/runs/44546195607/job/135637302942) at `b4882442`. Both use the reusable workflow at `7687a35d7522482bd8361d60dbc2589e9afbc81c`.

The [merged release candidate #12](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-reduce/pull/12) targets npm `pm-reduce@2026.11.6` (Git tag `v2026.11.06`, source merge `4eca4d796f11904ca729c39df0dfc22d365d7148`). Its preparation receipt records SRI `sha512-wMC2ad8iWksWNZnqOH2vs1W8adaoSORhTbYNnIwRsb+TQuxfDDix1nb8/w6LvFdAm4qAvfcAz3w5F5Kl0O6TeA==`. The [official npm coordinate](https://registry.npmjs.org/pm-reduce/2026.11.6) is already occupied with different SRI `sha512-cp7w7enJ0yLB8Wkn7SgQum1wm3OfVIYnquHakz1aYWSGdKFtMQNjokZojTN9yy+diB2IyyT9UJ4uxeGmrb+z+Q==`. It was published November 15 at 19:45:12 UTC, before the candidate merged November 16 at 17:27:40 UTC. Registry metadata exposes no attestation, and the exact padded Git tag and GitHub Release REST lookups return 404.

The [pinned registry proof](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ops/blob/7687a35d7522482bd8361d60dbc2589e9afbc81c/scripts/release-continuation.ts#L151-L160) treats the digest mismatch as unverified, which the [continuation decision](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ops/blob/7687a35d7522482bd8361d60dbc2589e9afbc81c/release-continuation.ts#L150-L152) must reject. This is an occupied-coordinate mismatch, not evidence of a bad npm Trusted Publisher setting, signer SAN mismatch, or package compromise. Re-running unchanged cannot repair it. Distinct from unbraind/pm-ops#270; related rollout: unbraind/pm-ops#272 and [native rollout task](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-reduce/blob/b48824420f34da8034c747932d1b53b670728c3a/.agents/pm/tasks/reduce-pm-reduce-release-caller-rollout.toon).

**Expected / acceptance:** Keep the artifact mismatch fail-closed. Record an operator-reviewed disposition for the stale occupied intent, then prepare current source as a fresh candidate at an unused npm version through the approved flow. Do not unpublish, overwrite, backfill a tag against mismatched bytes, relax provenance, or treat this as absent. Verify protected candidate CI and exact npm/GitHub digest, source/signer provenance, tag, release and Bun install for the eventual new version. On recurrence, report occupied/digest mismatch distinctly from a pending attempt or a verifier outage.

Evidence is exact read-only CI, public registry metadata and immutable source; no release transitions or provider settings changed.
